_comment: DUT console command table. Edit here when the SX1262-SDR repo's firmware commands are known; dut_serial.py has no command text of its own. Paths are relative to the lr2021-sdr (SDR:) and LakeShark (LS:) source trees analysed in the sandbox (commits 9706241b and 8586c6de). Command formats were read from GPL-3.0 code by SAMS0N1TE (lr2021-sdr, LakeShark); see ../TESTING-NOTES.md and the per-profile 'source' lists.

probe.done_regex: ^(sxprobe: end .*|usage: lora sxprobe.*|sxprobe: (no SX126x answering|no memory|the radio is busy.*|this board has no SX126x))$

source: LS:components/lakeshark/board/ls_lora_sx126x.c:1047-1093 per-step: optional CalibrateImage, tune, SetRx, GetDeviceErrors, GetRssiInst reads
LS:components/lakeshark/board/ls_lora_sx126x.c:1230-1251 output: 'sxprobe:' header, 'sxp,khz,err_cal,err_rx,st_cal,st_rx,n,avg_dbm,max_dbm,min_dbm,us' rows, 'sxprobe: end restore=... rx=...'

lakeshark_lr2021._gain_note: gain must be a fixed step 0..13 for the 10 dB attenuation check; 14 = host AGC (LS:ls_lora_lr20xx.c:4186) would hide the step

probe.done_regex: ^(lrprobe-spec: .*|lrprobe: .* bytes=0 .*|usage: lora lrprobe.*|lrprobe: no capture memory|lrprobe: too few samples for analysis)$

source: LS:components/lakeshark/board/ls_lora_lr20xx.c:4177-4199 argument parsing and usage text (kHz 30000..3800000, bw 31250|62500|125000|250000, gain 0..13 or 14 auto, boost -1..7, lf|hf|auto, ms 1..250, hex)
LS:components/lakeshark/board/ls_lora_lr20xx.c:4238-4244 'lrprobe: f=... tune=... errors=0x.... bytes=... result=... recovery=...'

LS:components/lakeshark/board/ls_lora_lr20xx.c:4122-4175 'lrprobe-spec: rate= segs= dc= rms= (dBFS) floor= dB pk1=+HzHz:+dB pk2 pk3' (1024-bin Hann average, floor = median bin, bins <3 from DC skipped)
SDR:research/rx-range-and-gain/tools/lrprobe.py:21-22 115200 baud, DTR/RTS low so the board is not reset

lr2021_sdr_standalone.status: verified against source; rate fixed at 125000 (BW 31.25 kHz); chip AGC left on, so the attenuation check may read short

capture.done_regex: ^(check: .* result=(PASS|FAIL)|usage: capture.*|radio initialization failed.*|internal RAM allocation failed)$

source: SDR:firmware/esp32p4/main/main.c:76-90 dump -> 'lrfifo-hex: <off> <hex>' lines, 'lrfifo-crc32: XXXXXXXX bytes=N encoding=iq16le', then 'lrfifo: bytes=...'
SDR:firmware/esp32p4/main/radio.c:225-233 info -> 'LR2021 ROM a.b frequency=... bandwidth=31250 configured=... errors=XXXX'

sx1262_sdr_tbd.status: Legacy generic placeholder; use heltec_v4_3_sx1262 for the implemented board-specific protocol. Simulation only.
sx1262_sdr_tbd.board: Heltec WiFi LoRa 32 V4 (SX1262 + external FEM; record revision and FEM mode in meta)
source: placeholder; see lakeshark_sx1262 for the reference command this stands in for

heltec_v4_3_sx1262.status: Bounded firmware protocol implemented; live runs require matching firmware identity and operator RF preflight
source: firmware/esp-idf/main/main.c: command output and arm/one-shot TX gate
firmware/esp-idf/main/sx1262.c: SX1262 SPI, RX probe, LoRa TX and bounded frequency/power controls
Heltec official HTIT-WB32LAF V4.3 pin map: https://github.com/HelTecAutomation/Heltec_ESP32/blob/master/src/driver/board-config.h
